title: Evaluate unseen scripts with frozen quality, cost, latency, and architecture-drift checks

root_cause_and_repair.root_cause: A8 supplies hash-bound TEXT_VALIDATED raw-source-to-Projection records, but no v3.0-owned evaluator previously froze both Golden and holdout identities before comparison, bound a candidate to the A8 run/result records, or prevented an evaluation result from being reinterpreted as media/visual acceptance. Historical holdout modules are read-only migration inputs and cannot supply that v3.0 authority.
root_cause_and_repair.repair: Added a pure A9 evaluation package. FrozenEvaluationPolicy seals only opaque Golden/Holdout IDs plus NormalizedSource digests, the v3.0 authority hash, evaluator implementation digest, and a frozen TEXTUAL_CONTRACT quality rubric. A candidate must match the presealed holdout identity and binds digest-only source-to-fact-to-draft-to-decision-to-VEC-to-Projection-to-output lineage to validated A8 run and result records.
root_cause_and_repair.integrity_hardening: The evaluator rehashes the authority and every evaluation source file before ranking, rejects statically visible evaluator write/mutation sites, rejects Golden/holdout ID or source-digest overlap, cryptographically binds every Pareto metric value to its measurement record, and fails closed on authority, graph, claim-ceiling, v4, media, or owner-approval drift.

checks.name: frozen_evaluator
checks.result: FrozenEvaluationPolicy requires the sole v3.0 authority path/hash, deterministic Golden/Holdout ordering, a hash-bound evaluator implementation, frozen TEXTUAL_CONTRACT rubric, and runtime_mutation_policy=FORBID. Evaluation rechecks these immutable inputs before ranking.

checks.name: golden_holdout_separation
checks.result: GoldenCase and HoldoutCase retain only opaque IDs and NormalizedSource SHA-256 values. The frozen policy rejects registry ID/source overlap, while every candidate must match a presealed holdout ID and its exact source digest.

checks.name: candidate_keep_discard
checks.result: Candidates with a complete v3.0 text boundary enter comparison; invariant violations are explicit DISCARD results, dominated valid candidates are DISCARD with dominator IDs, and only non-dominated valid candidates are KEEP. A batch with no KEEP candidate is explicitly FAIL_CLOSED.

checks.name: quality_cost_latency_complexity_pareto
checks.result: The frozen evaluator compares higher TEXTUAL_CONTRACT quality and lower cost_units, latency_ms, and complexity_units. Quality/telemetry values are bound to a measurement-record SHA-256 and a frozen textual rubric; they are not visual scores.

checks.name: no_runtime_self_modification
checks.result: The A9 evaluator is a frozen dataclass/pure report producer with no persistence API. Before every evaluation it hashes its package sources and scans them for write/mutation calls or mutation-capable imports; observed runtime_write_sites is empty.

checks.name: architecture_invariant_regression
checks.result: Candidate validation rejects authority path/hash drift, any accepted-node sequence other than I0,E0,S1,K1,B0,K2,B1,VEC,Projection,G0,DP, non-TEXT_VALIDATED claims, wrong frozen rubric, v4 writes, and production-switch assertions. The A8 adapter additionally validates canonical hash-bound run/result records and their source/output lineage bindings.

checks.name: no_text_only_media_claim
checks.result: EvaluationReport is capped at TEXT_VALIDATED and hard-requires external_media_started=false, media_visual_acceptance=false, owner_preview_approval=false, and production_switch_authorized=false. Incoming visual acceptance or owner-preview claims are discarded rather than elevated.

scope_exclusions: A9 creates no canonical facts, Director decisions, IDs, ticks, Boundaries, VECs, ProjectionASTs, runtime configuration, prompts, or model outputs; it reads digest-only lineage and immutable A8 result metadata.
No v4 production source, FeatureGate, production state, production entry, or production switch was modified; v4 remains the sole production entry.
No external media renderer, verifier, media run, frame evidence, visual acceptance, owner preview approval, or live external provider call was started or claimed.
The A9 test uses synthetic hash references only to exercise the evaluator boundary. They are explicitly not a substitute for A10 real media evidence or user approval.
Pre-existing tracked and untracked user workspace changes remain outside this A9 delta and were not staged or modified.
